contentBlocks.body: Array sort changes the original array. In app code that can create surprising bugs, so copy first when the caller should keep their original order.
Default sort compares strings, so numeric sorting needs a compare function.

knowledgeItems.prompt: Why copy an array before calling sort?

payload.explanation: Calling sort changes the original array, so copying first avoids side effects.

knowledgeItems.prompt: Return scores from highest to lowest without mutating the input array.
